investigation_notes.Description: Microsoft Defender Antivirus detected a Trojan (SparkOnSoft) on WKSTN-912A associated with user m.tamm@client.ee. The sample file $RYRO9NW.exe is located in a Recycle Bin path and is signed by Hawk Integrated Inc., with a SHA256 of 686d018c86c03165925ebd3773c622f182c93f54b98db9616bae86f5e8684e4c. Reputation results show strong malicious consensus (39 engines flagged; community score -61; 16 malicious votes). The file was quarantined successfully, and there are no recent related events on the host. Given the combination of a known trojan, suspicious file placement, and robust reputation signals, this alert should be treated as High Priority.
